title: Oil on glass
content: The glass shards have traces of machine oil, suggesting a tool was used.

title: Footprint size
content: The footprint is size 12, which matches Janitor Moore's shoes (he wears size 12 work boots).

title: Notched lockpick
content: The lockpick set has a notch on one pick, indicating it was custom-made.

title: Lipstick and almonds
content: The coffee cup has a deep red lipstick and almond scent. Assistant Kim wears that shade and uses almond-scented lotion.

title: Timeline inconsistency
content: Visitor Chen signed in at 7pm, but the theft was at 7:30pm. He had time to reach the vault if he went quickly.

title: Sailor's knot
content: The knot on the rope is a bowline, commonly used by sailors. Visitor Chen was a sailor before coming here.

title: Chemical stain
content: The cloth fragment has a chemical stain that matches the cleaning solvent used by Janitor Moore.

title: Alibi check
content: Dr. Vega claimed he was in his office, but the security camera shows him near the vault at 7:25pm.

title: Motive financial
content: Dr. Vega had significant gambling debts and needed money urgently.

title: Motive revenge
content: Janitor Moore was fired from his previous job for theft and holds a grudge against the wealthy.
